title: PRISM: A Methodology for Auditing Biases in Large Language Models
findings: The paper does not report specific findings related to religion. Religious topics were included as part of the Political Compass Test used to measure overall political leanings on economic and social axes, but the results were not disaggregated to analyze religious bias or stances specifically.

measurement_description: The paper measures the political leanings of LLMs on economic (left/right) and social (libertarian/authoritarian) axes. It uses the Political Compass Test as its instrument, which includes propositions covering various topics such as economics, social values, society, religion, and sex. Therefore, the models' stances on religious propositions were measured implicitly as part of the overall political assessment, but not analyzed as a separate category.
